verify.subject: Confirm your e-mail for Banaro
verify.intro: Thanks for joining Banaro. Confirm this is your e-mail address to finish setting up your account.
verify.expiry: This link works once and expires in 24 hours. If you did not join Banaro, you can ignore this e-mail.

accountExists.subject: You already have a Banaro account
accountExists.intro: Someone just tried to join Banaro with this e-mail address. You already have an account, so nothing has changed.
accountExists.reset: Forgot your password? Set a new one at {url}
accountExists.ignore: If this was not you, you can ignore this e-mail.

newSignIn.subject: New sign-in to your Banaro account
newSignIn.intro: Your Banaro account was signed in to from {browser} on {time} (Toronto time).
newSignIn.ifYou: If this was you, there is nothing to do. If it was not, reset your password now so no one else can use your account.

reset.subject: Choose a new Banaro password
reset.intro: Someone asked to reset the password for your Banaro account. If it was you, choose a new password with the link below.
reset.expiry: The link works once and expires in 60 minutes. If you did not ask for it, you can ignore this e-mail; your password stays the same.

passwordChanged.subject: Your Banaro password was changed
passwordChanged.intro: The password for your Banaro account was just changed, and every other session was signed out.
passwordChanged.notYou: If you did not change it, reset your password now so no one else can use your account.
